title: Research: JP8 coefficient reuse across all scalar phases (no new kappa)
body:
Finite complex-supplier circuit improvement; no new kappa.

Saves 18,510 forward and 46,400 backward real-component primitives beyond PR696. Both full scalar programs, 716 logical plus nine private input columns, prefix bounds and 14 negative controls pass. Concurrent PR722 cleanup sharing is credited; this adds other forward phases and 1,088 backward precondition runs. PR739 is also credited.

Full proof, accounting, source pins, certificate, validation and AI-assistance disclosure are in research/complex-coefficient-reuse/README.md.

Reproduce: python3 -B research/complex-coefficient-reuse/verify.py
